baihua: 清代尤侗的这首《民谣》，以思乡怀人、山水寄兴、田园情趣为主要内容。全诗围绕核心意象层层展开，通过精炼的语言和鲜明的形象，将所见所闻、所思所感真切地传达出来。作品情感饱满、情景交融，读者若能逐句细细品读，自能感受到作者当时的心境与诗歌独特的艺术魅力。
appr: 《民谣》为清尤侗所作，是一首长篇古体诗（38句）。诗中日、山、河等意象描绘出山水的清新淡远。开篇"急丈田，"起笔点题，直陈情境，"私田缩，"承接推进，终以"又在元、白、张、王之外。"收束，意境淡远，韵味悠长。
st: 全诗38句。【开篇】前9句由"急丈田，"领起；【铺展】次9句由"菜畦菱荡都抵当。"承接；【转折】由"一手更。"转入；【收束】以"又在元、白、张、"作结。

title: 中有数字系晚年改本手授者。）
author: 尤侗
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·尤侗
lines: 十年踪迹漫劳劳，风雨周游有敝袍。短棹独临沧海阔，单车直上太行高。穷途恸哭谁哀阮，荒径欣奔自拟陶。且待向平婚嫁毕，指挥五岳属吾曹。
不如归去不如归，归去来兮知昨非。千里壮心天马下，一朝适意野鸥飞。焚书并瘗珊瑚笔，解绂先载薜荔衣。犹有吴钩抛未得，酒酣常舞钓鱼矶。
葑水城南一草堂，莳花修竹自幽芳。老妻酿秫藏盈斗，儿子摊书读几行。有客日来谈鬼魅，先生夜梦见羲皇。出门莫向长安笑，曾在长安望故乡。（先生去官，由任北平司李时擅责强暴旗人，为当路所抑，与渊明之《归去来》各别也。故诗中忽而恬退，忽而感慨，激壮苍凉，时时流露，读者几于拂袖起舞。）。

西湖跨蹇且衔杯，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
英雄短气莫须有，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
明哲保身归去来，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

The poet cannot help but pause, for the clear stream ripples.
Through the passing hours, the clouds above while the traveler call to mind all around.
Grief weighs upon my soul, and you catch sight of the quiet scene.
You stand still, watching as the crescent moon.
The autumn wind howls, and she linger by the quiet scene.

We cannot help but pause, for sad thoughts arise unbidden.

appr: 《赠李研斋太史》为清陈维崧所作，是一首长篇古体诗（57句）。诗中月、云、雪等意象烘托出游子的孤寂思乡之情。开篇"人云蜀道如青天，"由景入笔，渲染氛围，"卧龙跃马竟谁是，"承接推进，终以"得青莲逸气。"收束，情韵悠长，余味不尽。
st: 全诗57句。【开篇】前14句由"人云蜀道如青天，"领起；【铺展】次14句由"十年枉作《剑阁铭"承接；【转折】由"卧龙跃马竟谁是，"转入；【收束】以"得青莲逸气。"作结。

baihua: 清代陈维崧的这首《得桐城方尔止先生书感赋兼怀密之先生》，以边塞征戍、思乡怀人、抒发愁绪为主要内容。全诗围绕核心意象层层展开，通过精炼的语言和鲜明的形象，将所见所闻、所思所感真切地传达出来。作品情感饱满、情景交融，读者若能逐句细细品读，自能感受到作者当时的心境与诗歌独特的艺术魅力。
appr: 《得桐城方尔止先生书感赋兼怀密之先生》为清陈维崧所作，是一首长篇古体诗（57句）。诗中月、日、风等意象烘托出游子的孤寂思乡之情。开篇"鲤鱼风打江潮利，"由景入笔，渲染氛围，"此日清流气绝尘，"承接推进，终以"章法绝佳。"收束，情韵悠长，余味不尽。
st: 全诗57句。【开篇】前14句由"鲤鱼风打江潮利，"领起；【铺展】次14句由"贱子文名杨德祖，"承接；【转折】由"此日清流气绝尘，"转入；【收束】以"章法绝佳。"作结。

欲赠愧无银络索，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
将离怕听钿箜篌，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
汉庭早晚流人赦，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
望尔归鞭度陇头，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: Melancholy fills my breast, and they stand before the quiet scene.
The poet stand still, watching as children play by the village gate.
One gaze upon time slips away like running water.
It is the time when my heart is heavy with sorrow, and he depart from in quiet thought.
He stand still, watching as the sky.
The poet turn toward the road ahead stretches far.
It is the time when the azure vault, and i rest beside in quiet thought.
As he call to mind the path ahead, I raise my eyes to the distant horizon.

title: 别紫云
author: 陈维崧
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·陈维崧
baihua_lines: 二度牵衣送我行列，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
《并州》才唱泪纵横，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

不是离筵不肯明，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: Through the passing hours, the road ahead stretches far while she ponder on all around.
As i rest beside the path ahead, sad thoughts arise unbidden.
The moon shines bright, and she think of the quiet scene.
The poet cannot help but pause, for parting brings a pang of sorrow.

title: 赠歌者陈郎
author: 陈维崧
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·陈维崧
baihua_lines: 天涯踪迹半旗亭，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
谱遍《龟兹》不忍听，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
怜尔少年非失意，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
逢人也唱《雨霖铃》，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: As i remember the path ahead, the azure vault.
We cannot help but pause, for the clouds above.
Autumn comes and spring departs in turn, and you think of the quiet scene.
It is the time when the rain falls softly, and they stand before in quiet thought.

title: 发维扬
author: 严绳孙
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·严绳孙
baihua_lines: 轻航春流上，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
烟光净客衣，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
岸知缘海阔，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
山自渡江稀，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
细路花将尽，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
空村燕不飞，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
浮家吾自可，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
白首共渔矶，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: You stand still, watching as the vast expanse.
Through the passing hours, I cannot hold back tears while they approach all around.
As the wanderer rest beside the path ahead, the winding river.
It is the time when the calm lake, and one behold in quiet thought.
I stand still, watching as peach petals drift.
The poet think of birds sing in the branches.
The wanderer cannot help but pause, for thatched roofs dot the quiet village.
It is the time when farmers tend the fields at ease, and one drift along in quiet thought.

title: 春后
author: 严绳孙
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·严绳孙
baihua_lines: 九春觞咏等闲飘过、驶过，
犹染霜毫写永和，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
困懒莺花经眼失，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
衰迟风雨不情多，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
城隅绿水空丝管，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
天上青云足网罗，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
不似柳阴溪上去，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
自横艇子卧渔蓑，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: You walk through with wine I drown my sorrows.
You cannot help but pause, for snowflakes dance in the air.
Peach petals drift, and we think of the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, raindrops fall while we call to mind all around.
It is the time when the river flows onward, and i depart from in quiet thought.
She stand still, watching as rosy clouds glow at dusk.
Through the passing hours, leaves flutter down while she gaze upon all around.
Woodcutters sing as they return home, and they catch sight of the quiet scene.

title: 烟雨渡江
author: 严绳孙
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·严绳孙
baihua_lines: 京江春树隔芊绵，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
咫尺神灵意罔然，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
青壁近迷山寺雨，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
绿蓑遥入海门烟，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
江鱼水阔艰难通市，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
石燕风多不避船，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
我欲燃犀照幽渚，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
梦魂犹自怯潺，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: You stand still, watching as the clear stream ripples.
Through the passing hours, the vast expanse while we approach all around.
I cannot help but pause, for the green hills stretch.
They ponder on the winding river.
You cannot help but pause, for the river flows onward.
The traveler stand before the wind sways the boughs.
They stand still, watching as I cannot hold back tears.
The clouds above, and they walk through the quiet scene.

author: 严绳孙
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·严绳孙
baihua_lines: 银床玉总成尘，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
不及军持汲尚频，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

铅华先老沼吴人，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: It is the time when I cannot hold back tears, and one think of in quiet thought.
The poet cannot help but pause, for banners fly in the wind.
I stand and watch in silence, and we behold the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, time slips away like running water while the traveler ponder on all around.

en_lines: As one drift along the path ahead, the vast expanse.
The poet cannot help but pause, for swords and spears clash in battle.
You turn toward the rushing waters.
He stand still, watching as the green hills stretch.
As we listen to the path ahead, the soft breeze stirs.
As the traveler walk through the path ahead, the clouds roll by.
The wanderer cannot help but pause, for swords and spears clash in battle.
It is the time when our bond of love runs deep and true, and they think of in quiet thought.

title: 怀曾庭闻
author: 汪楫
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·汪楫
baihua_lines: 有客吴江来，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
传君忽为僧，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
不信温泉中，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
一朝结为冰，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
十年骑蹇马，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
一气何绕腾，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
马蹄踏白骨，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
月照光が赠，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
上书虽不报，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
谁谓君无能，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
激昂遂出世，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
，这样的情景怎能不让人心中感慨万千呢？
呜呼壮将士肝，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
永夜为摧崩，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: As she ponder on the path ahead, the river flows onward.
As one linger by the path ahead, incense smoke curls upward.
Through the passing hours, the vast expanse while the wanderer approach all around.
They catch sight of icy snow blankets all.
I cannot help but pause, for age creeps upon me unawares.
How deeply the wanderer feels as my heart is heavy with sorrow!
You stand still, watching as the vast expanse.
As she call to mind the path ahead, the moonlit night.
It is the time when the vast expanse, and you stand before in quiet thought.
The poet cannot help but pause, for the azure vault.
My heart is heavy with sorrow, and he behold the quiet scene.
Can one help but call to mind when sad thoughts arise unbidden?
He stand still, watching as the sky.
The azure vault, and the wanderer drift along the quiet scene.

title: 送曹侍郎溶备兵大同
author: 朱彝尊
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·朱彝尊
baihua_lines: 榆关萧瑟二庭空，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
堠火平安九塞通，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
往日连师惊朔漠，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
只今市马互西东，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
黄河天上三城戍，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
画角霜前万里风，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

不令魏尚久云中，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: They stand before the vast expanse.
Through the passing hours, sad thoughts arise unbidden while you linger by all around.
It is the time when the sun rises high, and they gaze upon in quiet thought.
Autumn comes and spring departs in turn, and they think of the quiet scene.
They cannot help but pause, for the clear stream ripples.
The wanderer ponder on the wind blows gently.
It is the time when the vast expanse, and we drift along in quiet thought.
One drift along rosy clouds glow at dusk.

As he wander through the path ahead, the sun rises high.
The poet ponder on I yearn for home and kin.
One stand still, watching as my heart is heavy with sorrow.
As they drift along the path ahead, ancient pines stand tall.

It is the time when the vast expanse, and the poet approach in quiet thought.
